summary.text: Michael Nicholson is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 2nd Worcester District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against unenrolled candidate John Reilly Jr.
Ballotpedia lists him as an at-large officeholder of the Gardner Public Schools, and he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
